systems.country_label: CRVS, under the Vital Events Registration Agency (VERA; INVEA at federal level)
systems.owner: Vital Events Registration Agency, with structures and staff at national, regional and woreda levels
systems.tiers: registration centres at regional, woreda and kebele levels; not computerised at woreda level by 2018, the evaluation recommending computerisation of birth registration data at least to woreda level and where possible to kebele level
health facilities report birth notifications as an indicator; targeted woredas' use of the data for planning is a project indicator

note: Passages of a UNICEF evaluation covering 2014 to 2018: woredas appear as project areas and as a tier of civil registration and health planning; the passages state nothing on woreda offices' connection, and the only statement on computers is a recommendation to computerise registration data down to woreda level.
